limitations: Real 80B+MTP final production model evidence is native Windows ARM64 CPU only.
Earlier generic native proofs are historical and are not substituted for final specialized production validation.
Default-attention three-case proof predates the specialization overlay; generator and GDN are unchanged, and the exact specialization has separate component and final native application evidence.

The earlier full Linux sanitizer suite and Windows x64 emulation evidence are model-free recorded source snapshots; neither is final specialized full-application or real 80B inference proof. The specialized kernel overlay has separate focused Linux address/undefined/leak sanitizer proof.

Per-word/digest equality is limited to the fixed reference, strict replay, component checks and synthetic recurrence checks described in their sections. Session/default-attention checks assert functional transcript/state behavior, not blanket per-word equivalence.
Functional-run wall times are diagnostic only and are not model performance results. Raw component timing artifacts do not establish whole-model speed or promote defaults.
Explicit skips and historical test-only failures are retained and are not counted as exercised optional features.
Original artifact SHA256 values refer to original bytes before public-path normalization; recorded binary/source hashes are retained without rereading model files or executables.
